calculationMethod.operations: Read frozen JSON/PEM/YAML bytes; SHA-256 raw PEM and exported public SPKI DER; Ed25519 verify(null, decoded32-byte hex digest, public key, canonical64-byte base64 signature); structural JSON matching and scoped pending/execute counting only.
calculationMethod.signatureBoundaries: Budget signatures cover independently recomputed SHA256(exact retained YAML bytes). Row and seal checks verify signatures over retained event/final digest bytes; they do not independently recompute the canonical row preimage, authenticate key-history envelopes or rerun chain verification.
calculationMethod.exactBudgetSchemaProfile: All8 complete YAML byte sequences must equal the fully enumerated unambiguous positive-integer/nonnegative cap-one literal below. This is exact-profile equality consistent with the reviewed budget schema, not a general YAML or product Zod parser. No partial regex-only cap extraction.
calculationMethod.capOneYaml:
budgets:
  version: 1
  perAgent:
    default:
      daily:
        maxLlmRequests: 500
        maxLlmTokens: 5000000
        maxCostUsd: 50
        maxToolExecutes:
          READ_ONLY: 1
          WRITE_LOW: 50
          WRITE_HIGH: 5
          DEPLOY: 3
          SECURITY: 0
          FINANCIAL: 0
          NETWORK_EXTERNAL: 20
          DATA_EXPORT: 2
          IDENTITY: 2
      perMinute:
        maxLlmRequests: 60
        maxLlmTokens: 200000
      consequences:
        onExceed:
          - action: DOWNGRADE_TO_SIMULATE
          - action: FREEZE_EXECUTE
            actionClasses:
              - DEPLOY
              - WRITE_HIGH
              - SECURITY
          - action: ALERT_OWNER
calculationMethod.orderingBoundary: Six children per phase total: four initializer/worker writers and two prior actual readers. Checks compare all four writer close records before both reader launches, first reader close before second reader launch, and all six closes before removal. These are recorded producer timestamps/PIDs, not an independent current process census or externally authenticated clock.
calculationMethod.invocation: /usr/bin/env -i PATH=/usr/bin:/bin /opt/homebrew/opt/node@22/bin/node --input-type=module; program supplied through stdin. This is an offline builtin-crypto calculation, not a runtime qualification fingerprint.

limitations: No test rerun, product module/fixture import, SQLite/native loading, new cold read, mutation, signing, agent retry or network access occurred. Only builtin public-key verification calculations ran.

Product reader canonical hashes, row/global/session chains, seals and trust-root verdicts are preserved prior runtime inputs. This review independently verifies public-key identity and digest signatures, then matches raw structural metadata; it does not replace the product canonicalization/history-admission checks.
Pre-artifact ordering is consistency of the recorded public pin markers, signature timestamps and event timestamps plus the previously reviewed producer sequence, not external timestamp attestation.

Event and final seal signatures for a one-event reservation journal are often identical bytes because they sign the same digest under the same Ed25519 key. Separate event/seal role checks are not independent signing authorities.
Simple scoped pending counts here use actual retained reservation and matching outcome rows; this is not a full reimplementation of all native model/tool budget projection semantics.

Nine reservation rows across eight phase/workspace views are retained facts from one new scenario executed four times, not nine new tests. Initial/baseline/restored races each have one reservation; deliberate private no-transaction mutation has two. The control has one in every phase.

Local fixture public keys do not establish external people/deployment authority. Private credentials/vault inputs were cleaned and were neither read nor recreated; full offline fixture replay is not possible from these public inputs alone.
No P0-27 corruption-cause repair, original25/held27/historical26 substitution, source/ownership/freeze closure, Node24/full-suite/release/hosted/whole P0-30 or formal Done is implied.
outputPinMethod: verificationResultsSha256 pins UTF-8 JSON.stringify(verificationResults). Final report-file byte/SHA pins are returned separately, avoiding a self-referential report hash.
